QUOTE: #ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif — and "by default a field `foo` is actually named `private_foo`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro and states that by default the field is renamed to private_foo, and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes it expand to the bare member name.
